name: Brucknerstüberl
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Brucknerstüberl in Tirol!**

Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality in the heart of the Alps. Our cozy mountain inn invites you to savor traditional dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**, and crisp **Speckknödel**—all paired with local craft beers and fine wines.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, our rustic retreat offers breathtaking views of the **Zillertal Alps** and the **Karwendel**. Whether you're here for a relaxing getaway or an adventure in the great outdoors, we’re your perfect home base.

**Come experience Tirol’s warmth—where every meal tells a story!**
